# Product Scope Checklist: Trello MVP Auth

**Purpose**: Formal release-gate review of requirements quality across the full MVP scope, with emphasis on unauthorized data access risk.
**Created**: 2026-08-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are account creation, sign-in, sign-out, and return-to-workspace requirements complete enough to define the full authentication scope? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are protected resource requirements documented for every private resource named in the feature, including workspace, board, list, card, membership, and role information? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 Are first-workspace requirements explicit that successful registration creates a personal workspace automatically? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK004 Are board, list, and card management requirements complete across create, rename/edit, reorder/move, archive, and read behaviors? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004-FR-006]
- [ ] CHK005 Are invitation, membership removal, and role-change requirements complete for owner-managed collaboration? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008-FR-011]
- [ ] CHK006 Are workspace location and time/weather context requirements complete for owner updates, member visibility, unavailable data, and non-blocking board use? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014-FR-016]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Are role names and role meanings unambiguous and limited to the canonical `owner`, `editor`, and `viewer` terms? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK008 Are “board edit permission” and “card edit permission” clearly traceable to owner/editor roles without leaving a separate hidden permission model implied? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004-FR-006]
- [ ] CHK009 Are card minimum fields specified clearly enough to distinguish required fields, optional fields, derived status, timestamps, and selected assignee behavior? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the phrase “clear permission message” defined with enough specificity for consistent acceptance review across restricted actions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK011 Are archive requirements clear about whether archive is the MVP deletion/removal behavior for boards, lists, and cards? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004-FR-006]
- [ ] CHK012 Are “simple navigation” and “basic workspace settings only” bounded clearly enough to prevent extra MVP surface area from being inferred? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Are the registration story, first-workspace edge case, and FR-003 consistent about automatic personal workspace creation? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK014 Are owner-only location requirements consistent across user story text, acceptance scenarios, FR-014, data model rules, and API contract roles? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 4, Spec §FR-014, Data Model §Workspace, Contract §Workspaces]
- [ ] CHK015 Are viewer restrictions consistent between acceptance scenarios, functional requirements, authorization matrix, and contract endpoint role rules? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 3, Spec §FR-011, Data Model §Authorization Matrix, Contract §Required End-to-End Contract Scenarios]
- [ ] CHK016 Are editor permissions consistent between content-management requirements and restrictions on memberships, roles, workspace deletion, and location settings? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK017 Are out-of-scope declarations consistent between assumptions and plan constraints for QR sign-in, comments, attachments, labels, notifications, billing, public boards, mobile apps, and real-time collaboration? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Technical Context]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK018 Are registration and first-workspace success criteria measurable and tied to the clarified automatic workspace creation behavior? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK019 Are board/list/card workflow success criteria measurable across the minimum expected board, list, and card creation path? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the restricted-action success criterion strict enough to cover owner, editor, viewer, signed-out, and unauthorized signed-in states without ambiguity? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK021 Is persistence success measurable enough to define what counts as retained board, list, card, workspace, membership, and role state? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK022 Are time/weather success criteria measurable while still excluding provider-unavailable cases from failure of core board scope? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-005, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK023 Are usability success criteria specific enough to evaluate sign-out, board opening, card creation, and permission-message understanding without subjective interpretation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK024 Are primary scenarios documented for first-time registration, returning sign-in, private URL access, board management, role collaboration, and time/weather context? [Coverage, Spec §User Scenarios & Testing]
- [ ] CHK025 Are alternate scenarios documented for users with no existing workspace, users losing workspace access, empty boards, unavailable context data, and direct restricted requests? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 Are exception scenarios documented for invalid credentials, duplicate account attempts, invalid invitation tokens, expired sessions, and unauthorized assignee selection? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK027 Are recovery expectations documented for provider failures, stale sessions, and access loss while viewing a workspace? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK028 Are concurrent edit expectations clear enough to define latest-state preservation and duplicate-card prevention? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Unauthorized Data Access Requirements

- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements explicit that signed-out users receive no private workspace content before authentication succeeds? [Security, Spec §FR-002, Spec §User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK030 Are requirements explicit that signed-in users without workspace membership cannot read or infer private workspace, board, list, card, membership, or role data? [Security, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK031 Are requirements clear that authorization applies equally to normal UI paths, direct URLs, and repeated browser requests? [Security, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK032 Are membership and role mutation requirements sufficient to prevent non-owners from changing roles, removing members, or removing the workspace? [Security, Spec §User Story 3, Spec §FR-009-FR-011]
- [ ] CHK033 Are owner-only location update requirements covered as authorization-sensitive workspace settings rather than general member preferences? [Security, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK034 Are API error and hidden-resource requirements documented consistently enough to avoid leaking whether private resources exist? [Security, Contract §Common Rules]
- [ ] CHK035 Are session revocation, expiration, and sign-out requirements documented sufficiently for private data protection quality review? [Gap, Security]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK036 Are empty-state requirements defined for workspaces, boards, lists, and cards without implying unprotected empty error pages? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK037 Are requirements defined for a user losing access during an active workspace session, including when permission is re-evaluated? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK038 Are rate limiting, throttling, or abuse-prevention requirements documented for account creation, sign-in, and invitations? [Gap, Security]
- [ ] CHK039 Are requirements documented for invalid, slow, unavailable, or incomplete weather/time provider data without conflicting with board usability? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK040 Are requirements defined for preserving at least one owner in each workspace? [Gap, Data Model §Membership]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK041 Are third-party time/weather dependency assumptions documented with failure-mode requirements and provider-availability boundaries? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK042 Are storage and persistence assumptions reflected consistently between the spec requirements and plan technical context? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK043 Are future-enhancement assumptions documented clearly enough to exclude QR sign-in from MVP acceptance while preserving it as a later option? [Assumption, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK044 Are scale assumptions documented clearly enough to bound MVP requirements for small teams before real-time collaboration or advanced features are introduced? [Assumption, Plan §Technical Context]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK045 Are any remaining broad terms such as “simple,” “clear,” “usable,” or “basic” clarified with objective criteria where they affect acceptance? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-012, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK046 Are entity names used consistently across spec, data model, contract, and quickstart without conflicting synonyms for Workspace, Membership, Role, Board, List, Card, and Location Context? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities, Data Model §Entities, Contract §Common Rules]
- [ ] CHK047 Are requirement IDs and artifact references sufficient for tracing release-gate findings back to the relevant spec, plan, data model, or contract sections? [Traceability]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
